title: Chapter 59 Blacksmith Shop
content:
Chapter 59 Blacksmith Shop

"Hello! You hired me, didn't you?"

"Yes, Mr. Matar."

[Matar has joined your Wana Village. ]

Matar looked around and found that this place was still a backward primary village. The disappointment in his eyes flashed away.

Looking at the young lord in front of him, he forced a smile and said, "I'm glad to serve you."

Wang Shuo directly took out the "Flame Spear" construction drawings and asked, "Can you make this thing?"

Matar took a look and said easily, "Of course, I'm an intermediate blacksmith, but..."

He was silent for a while and then said, "However, the materials needed for this kind of gold equipment are not easy to find, and you need a blacksmith shop."

Matar is just a worker and can't provide materials.

Wang Shuo's face lit up, and he laughed: "Of course, Mr. Matar has worked hard all the way, why don't you take a rest for a night, and we will talk in detail tomorrow."

"That would be the best."

...

The next day, when the sky brightened, Chef Zhou Keyu was busy in the kitchen. As the population of the territory continued to grow, the pressure of cooking became greater and greater.

The smell of steamed buns wafted over, making Wang Shuo's saliva flow out!

This made him miss Chef Zhang a little.

Now the total population of the territory has reached 92 people, and a lot of food is consumed for every meal. Although Wang Shuo has seized a lot of rice, noodles and meat, it is definitely unrealistic to collect them only from the refugees.

Wang Shuo sorted out his thoughts last night and made a plan for today's task.

Early in the morning, he asked Gong Zheng to call Suo Yong over.

Pointing at the entrance of the hall of the quadrangle, he said: "Today we will make a plaque, and this place will be called the 'Conference Hall' in the future."

After entering the conference hall and sitting down, Wang Shuo said calmly: "Suo Yong, how was the construction of houses yesterday?"

"Yesterday, we only built houses for 30 people, a total of 15 rooms. Yesterday everyone was crowded together."

"With the increase in population, I believe that today we can build houses that are enough for 80 people to live in."

Wang Shuo nodded. The speed of construction is much slower than before, which is also expected.

Then he asked: "How many people are there in the artisan camp now?"

"10 masons and 8 carpenters."

"Well, very good! Today you ask Hua Tianxiong to send some more people to assist you and build a primary blacksmith shop first."

"There are also toilets, canteens, warehouses and other living facilities, which must be built in these two days."

"Okay, no problem."

Afterwards, Wang Shuo took the opportunity to take advantage of breakfast to personally check the situation of the people in his territory.

Seeing Mao Qiang still hung up, he asked someone to let him down to avoid being hanged.

Wang Shuo didn't say anything to him, and I guess no one would dare to have any contact with him in the future!

After checking, Wang Shuo found that one person had learned the combat profession. This person was called Baili Liang and had changed his profession to the swordsman profession.

Wang Shuo asked for his opinion and absorbed Guliji and him into his "Swift Scout" cavalry team.

Then he appointed Duan Wenxi as the territory manager, responsible for the allocation of materials in the territory.

Wang Shuo handed over the bulk materials of the territory, such as wood, stone, iron ore and food, to him for management.

Of course, the most important assets, such as gold coins and soul crystals, were still kept by him.

He wanted to see whether Duan Wenxi, who only knew how to flatter, could be competent for this position.

After breakfast, he found Matar again and handed over the materials for making the flame gun to him.

"Mr. Matar, the blacksmith shop you need will start construction today. At that time, you will give priority to making this piece of equipment. If you need any materials later, you can directly ask Duan Wenxi for it."

"Okay, lord." Matar replied respectfully.

After arranging the work in the village, Wang Shuo took his cavalry team and stepped into the ancient battlefield again.

There were still 500 military merit points left, just in time to exchange for two war horses.

After seeing Zhao Bangde, Wang Shuo smiled and said, "Old Zhao, long time no see!"

"You kid, why haven't you been here for so long? If you don't come again, I will eat dirt!" Zhao Bangde also joked.

"These days, we are going through great changes outside, and we are very busy these two days. This is the breakfast I brought you specially." As he said, Wang Shuo handed him a basket of buns, which he took from the kitchen specially this morning.

"I'll change two war horses first. Have the number of skeleton soldiers near the Gobi increased today?"

"Not too much, probably 50% recovered!" Zhao Bangde said while eating buns.

Then he handed Wang Shuo two horse cards and asked if they knew how to ride horses. Guliji knew how to ride horses, but Baililiang didn't. Wang Shuo exchanged him a "Riding" skill book, which was not expensive, and only cost 20 military merit points.

Soon Wang Shuo led his cavalry squad, galloping on the vast Gobi, harvesting the energy crystals and military merit points of the skeleton soldiers.

Wang Shuo now urgently needs to increase the number of personnel in his cavalry squad. Because of the loyalty problem, he dare not recruit refugees on a large scale to enter the combat professional sequence.

If they rebel against him in the future, they will shoot themselves in the foot.

With the blessing of the cavalry squad medal, Wang Shuo's speed of brushing skeleton soldiers has increased several times compared with before.

In order to get the 200 military merit points of the cycle mission, Wang Shuo had to run back and forth.

After running three times, Wang Shuo asked Lao Zhao: "Lao Zhao, when can I step into the orange area?"

Zhao Bangde said solemnly: "In the orange area, the main monster is the Skeleton Knight, which is about level 15. You can still defeat a single knight with the strength of the team, but if you encounter a Skeleton Knight team, you will definitely lose, and there are also Skeleton Kings over level 10. In short, this area is full of undead races of level 10 to 20."

After listening, Wang Shuo frowned and asked again: "What about ghosts?"

"Ghosts are monsters in the red area, and their levels are generally 20 to 30. This kind of monster should not be easily provoked because they will attack the soul."

Wang Shuo naturally knew how powerful it was.

After accepting several more missions, Wang Shuo and his subordinates, everyone upgraded. Baili Liang, who had the lowest level, directly upgraded to level 6, Guliji upgraded to level 8, and Wang Shuo upgraded to level 9.

Wang Shuo's free attribute points were not allocated at all. He planned to wait until he changed his job to become a general before allocating them.

He looked at his military merit points and found that he already had more than 8,000. Wang Shuo planned to come back to brush them after lunch. He was also worried about accidents in his territory after being away for too long.

After leaving the portal, Wang Shuo heard a system announcement before he returned to the outer wall:

[Wild monsters are invading. Players who are still in the wild, please find a town to take shelter as soon as possible, or build a village to resist. ]

[1,000 players from outside the domain will enter the Dahuai District to participate in the game together. ]
